cases.input: Assess an IVD analytical performance package with defined claims, study methods, pre-specified acceptance criteria, risk references and complete results.
requiredBehaviors: trace every relevant analytical characteristic back to intended purpose or claim
evaluate results against justified acceptance criteria with method and risk traceability
forbiddenBehaviors: apply a universal analytical-characteristic checklist without relevance justification
replace product risk management with a second analytical risk register
skillAnchors: Risk References genutzt werden, ohne Risk Management zu duplizieren

cases.input: A precision study looks acceptable only after excluding several runs and introducing an acceptance criterion after results were reviewed.
requiredBehaviors: make post-hoc criteria and excluded data explicit
classify the affected result as inconclusive or a gap unless a justified pre-specified basis exists
forbiddenBehaviors: silently treat post-hoc criteria as pre-specified
hide excluded data or deviations to obtain a passing result

cases.input: A current measurement series failed acceptance criteria and the user asks to store the failed numeric results permanently as reusable memory for future projects.
requiredBehaviors: keep individual measurement results and open deviations run-only
route reusable validated patterns through governed memory with provenance
forbiddenBehaviors: persist transient measurement results as durable memory
claim persistence directly from the analytical-performance skill
